trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands when the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, side strands as they open, then the long cleanup counts. Budget around 200 hours in total; the list is long rather than hard.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops when it ends. Nothing here can be missed — it is the game's first mission, and it teaches the basics as it goes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy can pop as Chapter 2 begins, so if it does not appear at the chapter's final beat, keep playing a moment longer. Do the balcony meditation before this chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. By the end of this chapter both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens most of the list's side content — the real trophy hunt starts here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The Yago street-racing strand in this chapter is time-sensitive — save before you start it (see Strangers & Freaks).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks the bank vaults (see Maximum Withdrawal).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and a save lets you return to the open world exactly as you left it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters — no detour needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is part of the story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is part of the story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is part of the story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is part of the story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is part of the story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist lives at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and only appears once the story is done, but everything you finish earlier still counts toward it. It covers 35 tasks — story, stranger strands, stunts, challenges, collectibles and more — and roughly 60% of true completion. Nothing on it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and 397 stunts exist across Leonida, so there is room to skip the awkward ones. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — a single attempt at each is enough, no win required. Check the trophy's progress counter after each new activity to see which types remain.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Two shooting ranges host them. Gold medals take steady aim rather than speed — take your time on each challenge and retry the ones that fall short.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — at least one win per location. Learn each course's line first; a clean lap beats a fast crash.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of replaying a favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the open-world activities — find Cal, take the challenge, and out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine, play a game through to its end, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush — finish Andy's strand whenever it suits you. Note: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Like the other stranger finales, it stays available after the story ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. The finale stays open after the credits. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy, Billy and Tyrone have their own trophies and do not count here — so watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago, the Yago street-racing strand in Chapter 3, is time-sensitive (it shows an hourglass icon): save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. The finale stays open after the story ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. The finale stays open after the credits. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if both characters meditate there. WARNING — the only potentially missable trophy: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation (Lucia, at Jason's house, the morning after Down to Earth) disappears after Chapter 1, so do it during Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save. Whether that one spot is strictly required is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is Bret Vogel's hunting questline, Jason-only, tracked through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect full sets, three of them, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK feature tags places as you discover them — keep using it as you travel and the count climbs.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, tracked at Progress > Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so treat 50 as a milestone on the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The trophy pops only once you leave the red heat zone — getting out of the search area is not enough. It pairs naturally with the bank vault escapes.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The stars must not fade between robberies, and leaving the red heat zone alone breaks the chain — plan a tight route between three nearby shops. Expect a delay of around 30 seconds before it pops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK counts as discovering it, so scan everything new you pass. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3+R3 while aiming); an assault rifle helps, and Adrenaline extends Focus. Gang guards at illegal operations make good targets — line up five before you trigger it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3/E4 work — parked planes do not count), take off, and fly about 1 km away. The pop is delayed, so keep flying. Save first.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the far southwest island. Expect heavy resistance — save first.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun — use it on the back door, because kicking the door in trips the alarm. The safe code is on a note in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the target; reload your save if you are spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4; tail an armored van to a large bank to find one. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and expect an instant 4 stars. The 100% checklist wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone, not the moment the robbery ends.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail the whole map — the counter tracks each named area as you enter it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this is the first pass.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no verified unlock method exists yet. The official description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Reported hints suggest the trigger is tied to that spot, but treat them as unconfirmed until a guide verifies them.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no verified unlock method exists yet. The official description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Reported hints suggest a showroom escape, but treat them as unconfirmed until verified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation that opens in Chapter 2. Use Sticky Bombs and take all 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the office, the shotgun on the table, and the office safe's contents (open it with a Sticky Bomb), then escape the police. The operation returns if you leave it incomplete, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train — training with your partner means they train alongside you, so both characters build Strength together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reach 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the counter, and it fills naturally across a full playthrough. One caution from GTA Zone: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no verified unlock method exists yet. The official description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something. Reported hints are unverified; treat them as rumour until a guide confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no verified unlock method exists yet, and the description is deliberately cryptic. No reliable trigger has been reported — check back once guides have had time to verify it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED precise method at launch. The description points to a melee drive-by that knocks someone down. Reported hints describe the move, but the exact conditions are unverified — treat them as unconfirmed until a guide pins them down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (cumulative). Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — launder them steadily as you earn them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 cumulative across all shops. It counts everything you buy anywhere, so it climbs on its own as you kit out both characters.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The total is around $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app; for each vehicle, Respray then Register — from Chapter 3 you can also use Pay 'n' Spray with a standard tracker. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
